'''Alec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and operated before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He began training a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Saren Valek]], but lost him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], then spent several years tracking the person who had seduced Valek.

Although respected by his peers, Alec was a loner among the Jedi Order, working undercover instead of in tandem with other Jedi. However, he developed a vast array of non-Jedi contacts, including outlaws and spies who helped him in his goals.

==Biography==
Alec was a little-known but respected [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] active in the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. He was training a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner by the name of [[Saren Valek]] until [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]. At that point, Valek was seduced by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] thanks to [[Karae Nalvas]], a fallen Jedi. Valek abandoned his master and took Alec's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with him.<ref name="CP" />

From that point onwards, Alec tracked Nalvas. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] approved Alec's self-imposed mission, confirming that Alec was in no danger of falling to the dark side because he only wanted to capture Nalvas to stop him from committing further evils, not to get revenge. As such, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] graciously moved out of Alec's way, allowing him to perform his mission any way he wanted, but they were also ready to provide him with backup should he asked for it.<ref name="CP" />

During the following three years, Alec tracked Nalvas but was unable to stop him. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Alec discovered Nalvas in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], acting under the pseudonym of entrepreneur [[Karae Nalvas|Fesvk Wefos]]. The Cularin system had its own [[Jedi Praxeum|praxeum]], the [[Almas Academy]], but Alec contacted the Academy, and they agreed not to take action until Alec or the Council asked them to.<ref name="CP" />

Alec discovered that Nalvas was building a city-sized flying fortress in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]], and Alec theorized that Nalvas would use it to destroy the other cities in the planet, which were the main business, industrial and distribution centers in the Cularin system, and provoke a war. Alec stole the blueprints of this artifact, known as the ''[[Conkesta]]'', and disappeared in the Genariusan city of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]].<ref name="CP" />

Depatar, the City of Masks, required any outsider to dress in disguise full time, so Alec got a mask of albino [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. The city was also a bureaucratic conundrum, so outsiders hired specialized [[permitor]]s to get them the required permits for anything. Alec hired [[Delan (permitor)|Delan]], a very good [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] permitor. He also hired [[Danil]], a guide and pilot, although Alec provided his own ship.<ref name="CP" />

During his stay in Depatar, Alec researched the local economy in the [[Grande Game]] casino, while also obtaining a good profit. He then visited a bar, [[Club 111]], where he danced and drank [[Ithorian brandy]] before leaving with Danil to go the [[Five Star Entertainment]] theater. As Alec needed to remain in Depatar for a time, Danil looked for a side job as theater porter, and Alec used a theater box to hide himself and his earnings. Alec also hired several soldiers to provide him with sniper cover if needed, but, as he felt he had no more need for a permitor, he paid Delan a week of vacation in [[Dorumaa]].<ref name="CP" />

Meanwhile, Nalvas understood what had happened, and recognized the presence of his old sparring. Pretending to be Wefos, Nalvas hired a team of adventurers in nearby planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to find Alec and the blueprints. Two weeks after Alec's arrival to Depatar, Nalvas told his employees that Alec was a missing courier who was carrying important documents of a new resource extraction device, and his company would suffer without them. Nalvas knew that, should his people find Alec, Alec would tell them the truth. He only wanted to keep Alec busy while Nalvas himself took the blueprints from his supposedly secret hideout.<ref name="CP" />

Alec noticed the newcomers sent by Nalvas following his tracks through Club 111 and Grande Game. He hired a group of out-of-town thugs to dissuade them, and a permitor for the thugs, [[Sadana]]. However, the newcomers were not persuaded and tracked Alec to the theater. Alec met personally with them, with his soldiers providing cover as intended, revealed himself as a Jedi and told them the truth about Nalvas. He refused to relinquish the blueprints, but offered to greet "Wefos." Alec convinced Nalvas's people to join him.<ref name="CP" />

Danil, Alec and his new friends went to Cularin to their rendezvous with "Wefos" in a local tavern, [[Bath Rabbud's]]. Nalvas did not appear, sending instead an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] with a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of himself mocking and showing the blueprints, and a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|frag grenade]] with which he intended to kill his enemies. The explosive was not as effective as Nalvas had expected. Alec survived, and promised to call his new acquaintances as soon as he could form a plan against Nalvas.<ref name="CP" />

In the following two weeks, Alec discovered that the ''Conkesta'' was almost operative and hidden near the core of Genarius.<ref name="ISC" /> Alec recruited Doctor [[Shilaea Motacc]], an expert in planetary propulsion who had been working for the false Wefos without knowing his real plans.<ref name="HITC">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds}}</ref> Alec provided Motacc with several [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], with whom she developed a computer virus to send the non-spaceworthy ''Conkesta'' to outer space, where it should be destroyed. This would require someone to sneak into the ''Conkesta'' and operate the propulsion main control.<ref name="ISC" />

Alec also dealt with a couple of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], who provided them with information: The ''Conkesta'' had a deal with a local [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, The [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], with the Brotherhood supplying the ''Conkesta'' with consumables and technology. Many of the pirates would be in the annual [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] party of nearby city of [[Tolea Biqua]], leaving their base with an skeleton crew. Alec decided that a small team could steal a shuttle from the pirate base, then go to the ''Conkesta'' in a ship that Nalvas would be waiting.<ref name="ISC" />

Alec contacted some independent adventurers, the [[heroes of Cularin]], sending a holomessage in a droid. He and Dr. Motacc met with them in the Bath Rabbud's, in the supposed [["fans of foreign drinks" meeting]]. Alec and Motacc asked the heroes to help them with his plan: If they could raid the ''Conkesta'' and load the virus, then Alec could go after Nalvas and try to capture him. Alec told them that, should the alarms activate, then they should escape and try again another day; however, Alec's plan included sneaking himself in the ''Conkesta'' and activating the virus during the chaos.<ref name="ISC" />

While the heroes of Cularin were performing their task, Alec found and chased Nalvas from the moment Nalvas left the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], but Nalvas eluded Alec. Alec then went to Tolea Biqua, discovered that the heroes of Cularin had succeeded in their mission, and greeted them during the city-wide party. Alec managed an honor reception for his friends, including Jedi from the Almas Academy and authorities from Genarius.<ref name="ISC" />

==Personality and traits==
Although he knew how to go unnoticed, Alec was a charismatic person who could easily attract other people to work with him, including Shilaea Motacc and several slicers and Bothans,<ref name="ISC" /> as well as at least ten soldiers or mercenaries during his stay in Depatar.<ref name="CP" /> He was nevertheless a lone wolf, rejecting the help of the Jedi Order or the Almas Academy in favor of a one-man approach to the mission&mdash;even if his mission, the capture of Karae Nalvas, had been fruitless for several years.<ref name="CP" /> Some people considered Alec paranoid and simply ignored him.<ref name="CP" />

Unlike other Jedi, Alec used both a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a lightsaber, which may have been built by someone else.<ref name="stat">In his RPG stats in ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths|Clouded Paths]]'', Alec has no ranks in ''Craft: Lightsaber'', a required skill to build a saber. He might have built a lightsaber and afterward lost all of his points in ''Craft'', but this is unlikely.</ref> Even then, he was very respected among the Jedi: The Almas Academy, recognizing that Nalvas was a threat, agreed to not move against Nalvas until Alec (or the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]) asked them to.<ref name="CP" />

Alec was a dedicated warrior, relentlessly tracking Nalvas to bring him to justice, but refusing any personal vendetta against him, thus avoiding the dark side of the Force.<ref name="CP" /> At the same time, he apparently considered Valek a lost cause, not worth a tear in his state as a servant of the darkness: Alec only talked about Valek as a powerful enemy to be vanquished.<ref name="ISC" />

Alec was on good terms with many Jedi, including several Jedi Twi'leks. He had never met [[Nerra Ziveri]].<ref name="ISC" />

Alec hired some of his helpers, including Danil, his personal pilot and guide to Depatar; and Delan, his permitor in Depatar. This staff was qualified, handsomely rewarded and ready to stay with Alec for unexpected lengths of time, suggesting that Alec had access to money to pay them. He was known to earn money gambling, and he might have used his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] skills to influence the randomness of the games. He did own a ship, but lacked the skills to pilot it.<ref name="CP" />

Although Alec's fighting skills and general prowess were well below his enemy Nalvas's,<ref name="stats">Comparing Alec's RPG stats from ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths|Clouded Paths]]'' with Nalvas's from ''[[A Mon Alone]]''</ref> Nalvas ran away from the system instead of dueling him. Later, Alec left the system to track Nalvas again.<ref name="ISC" />
